@@note: Russian, made for the device's UI from the mobile app's (mstream_music, lib/l10n/app_ru.arb, master bdb174e) and the terminal player's (mstream-terminal-player, locales/ru.yml, main b89ad0a) translations where they had the text or the term (both GPL-3.0, the same author's; their words, register and typography are kept: formal вы), and translated by a Fable agent (Claude) otherwise, then reviewed message by message by a second Fable agent. A machine translation, not yet reviewed by a native speaker: a review as a pull request on this file is welcome. The rooms the notes give are those the texts were fitted to (42356b7); the layout fixes since gave most buttons and pills 2-4 px more and Small when their font doesn't fit, so a few of the apps' words a note set aside would fit now (docs/I18N.md, phase 3, lists them for a native review). The mood filters' texts (November 2026, the Albums list's filters: mood.*) take the mobile app's words from mstream_music at d17c3fa5 (lib/l10n/app_ru.arb: its mood* keys, and clear for Clear); mood.albums_of, mood.tracks_of and mood.no_albums were translated by a Fable agent (Claude), in the app's words where it has them (its autoDjSeedNoMatch), fitted to en.json's rooms (a note says where a room made a text shorter), not yet reviewed by a native speaker. The mood filters' Auto DJ text (November 2026, docs/MOOD-FILTERS.md 8.2: autodj.status_waits_fit) was made the same way: the mobile app's autoDjSeedNoMatch and its word for the filters (moodFilters), from mstream_music master at d17c3fa5, fitted to en.json's room, not yet reviewed by a native speaker. The mood filters' Auto DJ page (November 2026, docs/MOOD-FILTERS.md 8, S5): mood.smart_filters, mood.any and mood.no_data are the mobile app's words from mstream_music at d17c3fa5 (lib/l10n/app_ru.arb: autoDjMoodTitle, autoDjAny, autoDjNoMoodData); autodj.smart_sub, autodj.status_fits, autodj.status_coverage_mood, autodj.status_few, autodj.status_few_sub, toast.autodj_few, toast.autodj_no_close, toast.autodj_plays_once, toast.autodj_no_mood and empty.no_track_fits were translated by a Fable agent (Claude), in the app's words where it has them (its autoDjNoMoodData for the mood, autoDjSeedNoMatch, mainSync for a sync), fitted to en.json's rooms (a note says where a room made a text shorter), not yet reviewed by a native speaker. The screen's touch setting (November 2026, Output > Touch when off and the glance it can show: settings.screen_touch, its three values and their lines, glance.hint; settings.screen_off_sub rewritten, since a touch no longer wakes the screen unless the setting says so) was translated by a Fable agent (Claude), in this file's words for the screen's other settings, fitted to en.json's rooms (a note says where a room made a text shorter), not yet reviewed by a native speaker. The listening stats' words (November 2026, docs/LISTENING-STATS.md 8.1: stats.window_all, stats.days_n, stats.today, stats.yesterday, stats.shelf_empty) are the mobile app's from mstream_music at d17c3fa5 (lib/l10n/app_ru.arb: its listening* keys), as it writes them; stats.title, stats.recent, stats.listened, stats.plays_label and stats.empty_title, too wide for their rooms as the app writes them, and stats.plays_n, which fits a shelf's rows but not the hub's Last 7 days line (stats.time_plays, Small 232 px: at 168 h it is 248 px at 9,999 plays and still 236 px at 118, in each of its forms), have short forms (below). The listening stats' other texts (November 2026, docs/LISTENING-STATS.md 8.2: toast.stats_needs_dates, toast.stats_needs_month, the rest of stats.*, format.day_month, format.weekday_date, format.day_range, format.day_range_month, day.* and month.*) take the mobile app's words from mstream_music at d17c3fa5 where it has them (lib/l10n/app_ru.arb: its listening* keys for прослушивания, засчитываются and Сеансы, listeningScopeSheetDevice for хранится, agoMinutes and agoHours) and the terminal player's from mstream-terminal-player at b89ad0a (locales/ru.yml: gui.nav.most_played for Популярные, gui.top.mp3 for the MP3 Player tab, sta.note_top_track for последнее, sta.empty_state_detail's 'пока вы слушаете', and sta.weekdays_short, sta.months_short and sta.day_label for the dates), and this file's words (Ожидание, Не хватает памяти, не читается, Карта вернулась, Наугад, Синтетическая as library.synthetic); the rest was translated by a Claude agent (Claude Opus 5.5), then reviewed by a second, fitted to en.json's rooms and to test_ui_library's with Библиотека's crumb (a note says where a room made a text shorter), not yet reviewed by a native speaker. The short forms written for the six ARB words that did not fit depart from the ARB (each one's note gives the widths): stats.title Статистика (the terminal player's sta.title), stats.recent Недавние (the mobile app's autoDjFirstSongRecent, the terminal player's sta.tab_recent), stats.listened Время (the mobile app's listeningByTime), stats.plays_label Прослушано, stats.empty_title Прослушиваний нет (without пока) and stats.plays_n '{0} просл.' (the terminal player's abbreviation, its column ПРОСЛ.).

@format.weekday_date.note: With a comma, as Russian writes a weekday before its date (Ср, 30 сен); the terminal player's sta.day_key has none, but it is a column's key, not a date.

@format.day_range.note: A spaced dash between two dates that hold spaces (28 сен – 4 окт), as Russian writes such a span (CLDR's ru, d MMM – d MMM); in one month, format.day_range_month keeps it unspaced between the numbers (4–10 ноя). '30 июн – 30 июн (UTC)' is 152 px in the Last 7 days header's Small 161.

@day.mon.note: day.mon ... day.sun are the terminal player's sta.weekdays_short, capitalized as labels (it writes them lowercase in running text).

@day.monday.note: day.monday ... day.sunday carry their preposition (в понедельник, во вторник), as only stats.big_day draws them: 'Максимум в понедельник: 2 ч 1 мин'.

@month.may.note: month.jan ... month.dec are the terminal player's sta.months_short, as it writes them (no full stop), in the genitive (мая), as a month here always follows its day.
